To compute the sample standard deviation of the dataset $\{-11, 9, 5, 15, -10, -15, 12, -25, -22\}$, we follow these steps:

1. **Calculate the mean**:
   $$
   \text{Mean} = \frac{-11 + 9 + 5 + 15 - 10 - 15 + 12 - 25 - 22}{9} = \frac{-42}{9} = -\frac{14}{3}
   $$

2. **Compute the squared deviations from the mean**:
   For each data point $x_i$, calculate $(x_i - \text{mean})^2$:
   $$
   \begin{align*}
   (-11 + \frac{14}{3})^2 &= \left(-\frac{19}{3}\right)^2 = \frac{361}{9} \\
   (9 + \frac{14}{3})^2 &= \left(\frac{41}{3}\right)^2 = \frac{1681}{9} \\
   (5 + \frac{14}{3})^2 &= \left(\frac{29}{3}\right)^2 = \frac{841}{9} \\
   (15 + \frac{14}{3})^2 &= \left(\frac{59}{3}\right)^2 = \frac{3481}{9} \\
   (-10 + \frac{14}{3})^2 &= \left(-\frac{16}{3}\right)^2 = \frac{256}{9} \\
   (-15 + \frac{14}{3})^2 &= \left(-\frac{31}{3}\right)^2 = \frac{961}{9} \\
   (12 + \frac{14}{3})^2 &= \left(\frac{50}{3}\right)^2 = \frac{2500}{9} \\
   (-25 + \frac{14}{3})^2 &= \left(-\frac{61}{3}\right)^2 = \frac{3721}{9} \\
   (-22 + \frac{14}{3})^2 &= \left(-\frac{52}{3}\right)^2 = \frac{2704}{9} \\
   \end{align*}
   $$

3. **Sum the squared deviations**:
   $$
   \text{Sum of squared deviations} = \frac{361 + 1681 + 841 + 3481 + 256 + 961 + 2500 + 3721 + 2704}{9} = \frac{16506}{9}
   $$

4. **Calculate the variance**:
   $$
   \text{Variance} = \frac{\text{Sum of squared deviations}}{n - 1} = \frac{16506}{9 \times 8} = \frac{16506}{72} = \frac{917}{4}
   $$

5. **Take the square root of the variance**:
   $$
   \text{Sample Standard Deviation} = \sqrt{\frac{917}{4}} = \frac{\sqrt{917}}{2}
   $$
